description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Web and domain checks] Connects to host:443 and reports the certificate: trusted or not (and why), hostname match, issuer, valid from/to, days left, expired / expiring within 21 days, SAN list, wildcard, key type and size, serial, SHA-256 fingerprint, OCSP/CA URLs, chain, TLS version, cipher and ALPN. Cached 1 h. ~0.2-1.5 s.

host.description: Public host name, e.g. example.com or www.example.com (a URL also works)

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

name: ssl_cert

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.
